name: dainty-dash
description: Dainty Lass's remote management dashboard, launcher page and server manager page, on one theme

scripts.build: bun run --filter @dainty/theme build && bun run --filter './apps/*' build
scripts.build:launcher: bun run --filter @dainty/theme build && bun run --filter @dainty/web build:launcher
scripts.build:manager: bun run --filter @dainty/theme build && bun run --filter @dainty/web build:manager
scripts.typecheck: bun run bridge-data && bun run --filter './apps/*' --filter './packages/*' typecheck
scripts.demo: bun run --filter @dainty/theme build && bun run --filter @dainty/web demo
